calculator.title: Farmer Net Profit & Cost Calculator
calculator.subtitle: Calculate your expected net earnings, total marketing expenses, and break-even selling price per quintal.
calculator.quickEstimateNote: Demonstration estimate based on standard Karnataka rates (freight ₹2.25/km/qtl, storage ₹3.50/qtl/day). Adjust to your actual expenses.
calculator.explanationProfit: After deducting ₹{{expenses}} in total expenses from your gross sales of ₹{{revenue}}, your estimated net return is ₹{{net}} (₹{{netPerQtl}} per quintal).
calculator.explanationLoss: Your expenses of ₹{{expenses}} exceed your gross revenue of ₹{{revenue}} by ₹{{deficit}}. You need a selling price of at least ₹{{breakEven}} per quintal to avoid a loss.
calculator.disclaimer: DISCLAIMER: This calculation is for educational and planning estimates only. Actual market earnings depend on auction bidding, grading, actual transport freight, and market cess. Not guaranteed profit.
calculator.valQuantityPositive: Harvest quantity must be greater than zero.
calculator.valInvalidNumber: Please enter a valid numeric value.

harvestSplit.title: Smart Harvest Split
harvestSplit.subtitle: LP-based optimization: decide how much to sell immediately and how much to store — with full cost accounting.
harvestSplit.demo_banner: ⚠ DEMO DATA — All prices, forecasts and costs are simulated. Not actual mandi prices.
harvestSplit.risk_conservative_desc: Uses pessimistic forecast prices. Prioritises immediate sale to avoid risk.
harvestSplit.risk_balanced_desc: Uses base forecast prices. Balanced trade-off between immediate and future revenue.
harvestSplit.risk_growth_desc: Uses optimistic forecast prices. Holds more stock expecting higher future prices.
harvestSplit.mandi_selection_hint: Leave empty to consider all Karnataka mandis
harvestSplit.backend_offline: Backend offline — please start the FastAPI server.
harvestSplit.zero_storage_info: Storage capacity is 0. All produce will be allocated to immediate Day 0 sale.

community.title: Farmer Community & Mandi Transparency
community.subtitle: Share mandi experiences, verify weighbridge slips, discuss prices, and report market concerns.
community.demo_banner: DEMO MODE — All posts, comments, and reports are simulated demonstration data. Sensitive personal info is never collected.
community.guideline_1: Share honest, verified observations from your APMC visits.
community.guideline_2: Do not post phone numbers, Aadhaar, bank details, or passwords.
community.guideline_3: Do not make unverified accusations against specific individuals or traders.
community.guideline_4: Grievance submissions are logged for verification before action is recommended.
